description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. M. P. Nadaraja as a member of the Nothern Province Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a Provincial Council, which is an electoral process matter. It references the Provincial Councils Elections Act and involves the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a seat vacated by resignation. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and declarations, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
